symbols.name: FileSystemStore
symbols.summary: Coordinates filesystem manifests, immutable payloads, retention and explicit recovery.
symbols.remarks: This low-level API is for trusted tooling operating on a provider-owned root. Paths and records must come from this store. Acquire key authority before reading metadata used by a mutation or opening its selected payload. Keep it through publication. All cooperating participants must use the same protocol. Shared deployment and power-loss qualification remain separate.

symbols.summary: Gets or sets a synchronous diagnostic callback at staging, publication and reclamation boundaries.
symbols.remarks: Leave null in normal operation. Callbacks run within storage operations and may hold authority. Throwing simulates failure, can produce an indeterminate result, and may require explicit quiescent recovery. Boundary names are diagnostic events rather than a scheduling or concurrency contract.
